notes: v2.9.34: accumulation now has a hard previous-volume gate. A bar can NEVER be accumulation unless its current volume is strictly greater than the previous bar's volume. Therefore any blue/decreasing-volume bar is excluded even if its absolute volume is large, it has a long upper wick, it is a large bearish candle, or it otherwise looks unusual. Equal volume is also excluded. The same gate is applied to watermelon large-money volume footprints and recent impulse evidence, so declining-volume bars cannot be used as accumulation/large-money volume evidence. The accumulation settings UI now states this rule explicitly. Arrow, Bowl-3, zoom and live-order rules remain unchanged.
